theme: An open day, then an afternoon train down to DC.
greeting: A quiet, open Thursday, Dan — the day is yours until the afternoon Acela carries you down to Washington. The girls are with Jen this stretch, and tomorrow night a late flight points you toward Maine.

schedule.title: Train to Washington, DC
schedule.detail: Down from New York, into Union Station by 6:16 PM.

inbox.noise: Just a WeatherTech promo landed overnight.
inbox.clear: No urgent, security, financial, or job-search mail.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A cold, silky bowl for a hot travel day — cucumbers are at their August peak and it asks nothing of you at the end of a train ride south.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
